quest.title: Mondstadt Glider
quest.description: As it turned out, the book Amber gave you wasn't a manual, but a fairy tale... After completing the first test out in the wild, you learn that the second test is to take place within the city of Mondstadt itself. Amber is waiting for you there.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x225, Mora x5525, Adventurer's Experience x3, Fine Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Go to the door of Mondstadt Cathedral

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey — here, over here!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I'm all set up. Let's carry on with the exam.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Same deal as before, glide through the markers and get to the finish without stopping in the middle.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

talks.objective: Follow the route and fly to the finish line in time
Follow Amber's instructions and take the exam again

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Keep a firm grasp on the wind glider and let the wind guide you.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Seems like you've got the hang of wind gliding now! Let's do the final stage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Easy! You've flown this way before anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Once you've passed this final stage, you'll finally be able to get your very own gliding license.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Just keep thinking about that license. Ready...

talks.objective: Follow the markers to arrive at the finish line in time
Follow the route and fly to the finish line in time

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You can do it! Your gliding license is within your grasp!

talks.objective: Reach the doors of the Adventurers' Guild
Undergo inspection by the Knights of Favonius

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: I am Otto of the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: Please show me your gliding license.

choices.text: Ahh... my um, gliding license is, uh...

response.speaker: Otto
response.text: It is against the law to glide without a license! I am arresting you under Section 7, Article 12 of the Mondstadt Penal Code.

response.speaker: Otto
response.text: You have the right to remain silent. Anything you say will forever carry on the wind.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Wait... I'm an instructor. This is a gliding exam.

response.speaker: Otto
response.text: Well, you picked a bad time to hold your gliding exam.

response.speaker: Otto
response.text: The Knights of Favonius received a report from a Sister at the Cathedral claiming she saw Raptor gliding around these parts. I thought your student here must have been his partner in crime.

response.speaker: Otto
response.text: A known criminal in Mondstadt. He always uses a wind glider to commit his crimes, so people started calling him Raptor.

response.speaker: Otto
response.text: So far we haven't managed to catch him... Our plan this time was to draw him into the Cathedral with a precious artifact, and ambush him inside.

response.speaker: Otto
response.text: Fortunately, one of the Sisters put some secret markings on the artifact using elemental magic!

response.speaker: Otto
response.text: ...But he was too fast, and we couldn't even keep up with the trail the markings left behind.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Well, if you need help chasing down a gliding criminal, I'm the one for the job! So tell me, which way did he go?

response.speaker: Otto
response.text: As far as I know, he was last seen near Springvale, but that was some time ago.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: #Leave it to me! With me and {NICKNAME} chasing him down together, he doesn't stand a chance.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Once we've got this Raptor guy, we'll pick up where we left off.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But no need to worry... I'll be sure to have a word with Jean.

choices.text: It got eaten by Baron Bunny...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You didn't hurt yourself, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Once you're ready, let's try again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll think about it.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Before you launch, make sure you're completely ready.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Try to stay calm. You need to be brave at takeoff, but the trick to a good landing is to keep your cool.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm going to take another look around.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Take your time, I'll be right here when you're done.
